units.source_text: 开始弹奏第三曲《都鸟》的时候，多半是由于这首曲子优美柔和，

en.t: When she began playing the third piece, Miyakodori, probably because the piece was so graceful and gentle,

units.source_text: 岛村脸上起的鸡皮疙瘩开始消失了，他变得温情而平和，呆呆地凝视着驹子。

en.t: the goose bumps on Shimamura's face began to fade, and he grew warm and peaceful as he gazed blankly at Komako.

units.source_text: 这么一来，他深深感到有着一种亲切的感情。

en.t: In this way, he felt deeply a sense of intimate affection.
